summary: The 541525 Compression Floor Mount Adapter gives you an easy way to put a permanent target location in the floor or wall without using epoxies or other adhesives.
specs: Install the 541525 into a 1.38” x 1.9” hole that is drilled in a concrete floor or wall. The top will be flush with the surface of the floor or wall.
May be used with any 1.5” diameter SMR.
title: 541525 Compression Floor Mounts Adapter
